### `PUT /access/acl`

```ts
proxmox.access.acl.$put()
```

Update Access Control List (add or remove permissions).

Returns nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delete` | boolean |  | Remove permissions (instead of adding it). |
| `groups` | string |  | List of groups. — format `pve-groupid-list` |
| `path` | string | yes | Access control path |
| `propagate` | boolean |  | Allow to propagate (inherit) permissions. — default `1` |
| `roles` | string | yes | List of roles. — format `pve-roleid-list` |
| `tokens` | string |  | List of API tokens. — format `pve-tokenid-list` |
| `users` | string |  | List of users. — format `pve-userid-list` |
